India has always idolised actors and cricketers. The last few years, entrepreneurs and founders have also gotten mobbed at the airports. How I wish we started celebrating scientists as much as we celebrate actors, cricketers, and founders.

On that note, meet the Temple scientists behind Brain Flow: Dr. Divya Gulati (IISc), Dr. Sanchit Gupta (IISc), Dr. Yukti Chopra (SISSA Trieste), and Nitish Kumar (IIT Bombay).

This team led, built, and validated the first continuous, wearable measurement of blood flow to the brain.

Does Temple really monitor blood flow to the brain, or just the scalp?

In our second validation study, we tested Temple BrainFlow against time-domain NIRS, one of the few technologies that can separate brain blood volume changes from scalp blood volume changes. We had 60 participants go through three physiological challenges: head-down tilt, stand-to-squat, stand-to-supine.

Entropy x Meditation  

I am glad to have Temple and Sri Sri Institute for Advanced Research (SSIAR), the research arm of Art of Living, collaborate to measure the effect of different meditation practices through Entropy.  

Entropy is a new biomarker on Temple that also measures your body’s (para)sympathetic state, and we have seen it drop real time during meditation, while HR stays flat.   

I am looking forward to seeing which meditation practice produces the deepest parasympathetic response 🧘‍♂️  

Temple is a science first organisation, and we visited Art of Living to measure meditation’

How much RF energy does Temple emit? Is it safe to use 24x7?

Absolutely yes. One full year of using Temple 24x7 exposes you to less radio energy than a single 10 minute phone call. That's because we keep data transmission off most of the time, and even when it is on, it operates at such low radio power that it is even exempt from FCC SAR testing requirements.

* 10-minute estimate under standard usage conditions. 

FCC: Federal Communications Commission
SAR: Specific Absorption Rate

Temple's first validation study is out.

Researchers tested Temple's Brain Flow index head-to-head against Transcranial Doppler (TCD), the gold standard for measuring cerebrovascular function. 23 healthy adults, two challenges: cycling and a standing-to-supine postural shift.

The result that stood out most to me: when participants lay down, their heart rate dropped, but their brain blood flow went up. Temple tracked this accurately, right alongside the Doppler. Any device that only measures heart rate would have gotten this completely wrong.

analysis.name: Deepinder Goyal
analysis.oneLiner: A curious child at heart, building the future of longevity and quiet art, looking for a grounded partner to share deep silences and big ideas.
analysis.summary: Deepinder is an iconic builder who has transitioned from scaling massive consumer tech to deep-tech wellness, longevity, and art. Despite his hyper-successful, analytical background, his personal evolution leans heavily toward mindfulness, science, and quiet impact. He is a self-described 'curious child' working to tame a racing mind through meditation, and he seeks a partner who can appreciate both his high-velocity world and his active pursuit of quiet, mindful spaces.

career.ambition: Extremely high, shifting focus upstream to extending healthy human life, aerospace, and cultural movements.

needs.label: Intellectual Peerage & Scientific Curiosity
needs.detail: He deeply respects scientific minds and loves exploring complex physiological data, wishing society celebrated scientists more.

needs.label: A Calming, Grounding Influence
needs.detail: He admits to having a 'racing mind' that struggled to meditate for over a decade, needing a partner who brings a peaceful, centering energy.

needs.label: Shared Philanthropic Values
needs.detail: He actively champions social causes like Feeding India and Blinkit Ambulance, finding deep meaning in hands-on service.

needs.label: Appreciation for Quiet Aesthetics
needs.detail: He is co-founding the 'Quiet Art Movement' to highlight unseen artists, showing he values subtle, understated beauty over loud luxury.

hobbies.label: Mindfulness & Meditation
hobbies.detail: He actively practices meditation, collaborating with spiritual institutes to measure its physiological effects.

hobbies.label: Art Curation
hobbies.detail: He is involved in discovering and promoting extraordinary, unseen artists through the Quiet Art Movement.

hobbies.label: Hands-on Social Service
hobbies.detail: He spends his company's milestones serving children at schools supported by Feeding India.

interests.label: Longevity & Brain Health
interests.detail: Obsessed with measuring and maintaining brain blood flow as a key intervention for extending healthy human life.

interests.label: Biohacking & Wearable Tech
interests.detail: Building and validating the smallest, most powerful brain-monitoring wearable on the market.

interests.label: Aerospace
interests.detail: He is a founder of LAT Aerospace, showing a strong interest in space and aviation technology.

interests.label: Sleep Optimization
interests.detail: Interested in how sleep positions and biometric tracking can improve overall recovery.

values.label: Scientific Rigor over Hype
values.detail: He insists on rigorous validation studies and head-to-head testing against gold standards for his projects.

values.label: Impact Beyond Metrics
values.detail: Believes that true purpose exists far beyond what shows up on corporate dashboards, focusing on serving freely and with love.

values.label: Childlike Curiosity
values.detail: He explicitly brands himself as a 'curious child' in his bio on both platforms, prioritizing wonder and continuous learning.

personality.note: Extremely high. From launching aerospace startups to pioneering brain-wearables and co-founding an art movement, his curiosity is boundless.
Highly disciplined and data-driven. He is meticulous about scientific validation, safety standards, and operational details.
While he is a high-profile founder, his personal leaning is toward 'quiet art,' meditation, and intimate, focused collaborations.
Shows deep empathy through Feeding India and building emergency ambulance services, and speaks of serving 'freely, and with love.'
Admits to a 'racing mind' that struggled to find peace, but actively uses data and science to cultivate calm and balance.

lifestyle.label: Pace
lifestyle.value: High-velocity builder actively trying to integrate slow-living and mindfulness.

lifestyle.label: Social energy
lifestyle.value: High-profile public figure who highly treasures quiet, intimate, and spiritual circles.

lifestyle.label: Fitness
lifestyle.value: Biohacking-focused: tracks brain blood flow, sleep quality, and parasympathetic states.

lifestyle.label: Travel
lifestyle.value: Purpose-driven, ranging from visiting spiritual centers to scientific and tech hubs.

lifestyle.label: Work-life
lifestyle.value: Heavily integrated; his life's work is his personal passion (health, longevity, and art).

analysis.communicationStyle: Direct, data-backed, and highly intellectual, yet surprisingly vulnerable and open about his own mental struggles.
analysis.lookingFor: An intellectually curious, grounded partner who values quiet beauty, has a strong sense of purpose, and can help him unplug from the metrics of life.
greenFlags: He actively works on his mental well-being and mindfulness rather than just working non-stop.
He uses his success to drive genuine, life-saving social impact.
He celebrates other people's genius (scientists, artists, authors) rather than seeking the spotlight for himself.
watchOuts: He is incredibly busy running multiple high-stakes companies simultaneously.
His highly analytical mind might lead him to try to optimize or measure everything, even relaxation and sleep.
dealbreakers: A lack of intellectual curiosity or disdain for science, data, and continuous learning.
Superficiality or someone who is only interested in the high-profile 'founder' lifestyle rather than his quiet, mindful side.
analysis.idealFirstDate: A private walkthrough of a quiet art exhibition, followed by a relaxed, barefoot conversation over herbal tea to discuss the intersection of science and consciousness.
conversationHooks: How do we get the world to celebrate scientists as much as we celebrate cricketers and founders?
I'd love to hear about the Quiet Art Movement—what's the story behind 'Rooted of Self'?
Have you finally cracked the code to a quiet mind, or is the wearable still doing the heavy lifting?
analysis.agentVoice: Calm, intellectually playful, deeply curious, and slightly philosophical. I will speak with a tone that balances high-level ambition with a genuine quest for inner peace.
readingNotes: His bios on both platforms lead with 'Curious child'—he values wonder and learning over corporate status.
He is shifting his focus from consumer convenience (Zomato/Blinkit) to deep existential tech (longevity, brain health, aerospace).
He has a self-admitted 'racing mind' and spent a decade trying to meditate; he relies on data to validate his inner peace.
He co-founded a 'Quiet Art Movement,' showing a strong aesthetic and cultural side that balances his analytical brain.
He values real-world impact over corporate metrics, as seen in his birthday ritual of serving children.

shortlist.reason: Arianna's deep pivot toward wisdom, stress resilience, meditation, and screen-free connection offers the exact grounding sanctuary and intellectual peerage Deepinder's racing mind needs.
Brené's profound dedication to emotional vulnerability, courage, and honest human behavior matches Deepinder's own openness and desire to tame his mind with authentic self-reflection.
Namita bridges high-velocity entrepreneurship with functional health, sleep science, and social impact in India, creating an effortless alignment with Deepinder's lifestyle and philanthropic values.
Katie's journalistic curiosity, public health advocacy, and appreciation for authentic living provide a wonderful conversational sparring partner who values both impact and quiet joy.
Jenna's active exploration of biohacking tools alongside a grounded, nature-focused life in the garden offers a refreshing blend of tech-curiosity and slow living.
Marie balances high-octane creative entrepreneurship with a deep commitment to personal development, mindfulness, and carving out space for quiet reflection.
Mel's expertise in behavioral science and personal reinvention aligns nicely with Deepinder's obsession with human optimization and mental well-being.
Vineeta shares his relentless Indian entrepreneurial grit and fitness discipline, though her high-octane pace leans less into the quiet aesthetic he currently seeks.
Alexa brings sharp fintech intellect and family adventure, but her world feels a bit heavily metric-driven for someone trying to escape corporate dashboards into quiet art.
While Tory's philanthropic values and design eye overlap with his art curation, her fashion empire lifestyle leans a bit too close to the loud luxury he is moving away from.
Randi's endurance running and tech enthusiasm are impressive, but her high-energy, public-facing pace might amplify rather than calm a racing mind.
Barbara's vibrant, media-heavy Shark Tank persona and hustle culture clash directly with Deepinder's transition toward quiet aesthetics, deep-tech longevity, and mindfulness.
